summary: Checked both added class-level docs (JavaDurationOps at line 26 and ScalaDurationOps at line 36) plus their @param duration tags against the implicit classes' bodies and the delegated javaapi.DurationConverters.toScala/toJava implementations; both accurately describe the extension method each class adds, the conversion direction, and the target type, and both follow Scaladoc conventions (standalone first sentence, backticked code, wiki-style links, lowercase no-period @param continuations). No blockers found.

bonus_findings.issue: Pre-existing object-level doc opens with the self-referential "This object provides extension methods...", which the style guide asks writers to avoid.
bonus_findings.suggestion: Rephrase to describe the thing directly, e.g. "Provides extension methods that convert between Scala and Java duration types."
